description: Look up a book by its ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (hyphens and spaces allowed): title, subtitle, authors, publishers, publish date, page count, subjects, language, cover image and Open Library link, from Open Library's catalogue (CC0). The ISBN check digit is verified first; an invalid or unknown ISBN is refused uncharged. Use to enrich a reading list, a product listing or a citation. Example: isbn=9780140328721. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
